title: Apply for a fine reduction
summary: You can apply to reduce certain types of fines by 50% if you meet the eligibility requirements.
intro: You can apply to reduce some types of fines by 50% if you meet the eligibility requirements.
who_can_apply: Have not yet paid the fine
Were receiving a government assistance payment at the time of the offence
Have not had 4 or more similar fines within 12 months of the offence date
Are not applying about a serious offence and have not had a serious offence in the last 12 months

how_to_steps.text: Call Revenue NSW on 1300 138 118 to request a fine reduction.

external_links.text: Difficulty paying your fine – NSW Government

faqs.q: Who can apply for a fine reduction?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you have not yet paid your fine, were receiving a government assistance payment at the time of the offence, and meet other criteria, such as not having had 4 or more similar fines within 12 months, and not applying for a serious offence if you haven't had one in the last 12 months.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a fine reduction?
faqs.a: You must call Revenue NSW on 1300 138 118 to request a fine reduction.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a fine reduction?
faqs.a: You need your fine notice number and your personal and contact details.
